tool.description: 创建监控。先查实际投递目标，再填关键词、发送者或两者。每类内部取 OR，两类之间取 AND。只监控一个群时同时限定账号和群。默认启用，后续命中可能触发通知；既有历史不会自动重放。

platform.description: Notification platform of the existing targets and rule.

keywords.description: Literal keywords ORed together; not the Boolean q search syntax. Empty is allowed for sender-only rules.

matchType.description: Existing case-insensitive matcher: substring, trimmed whole content, or regex (maximum 200 characters per pattern).

sourceAccounts.description: Owned source account IDs. Empty means all owned accounts.

sourceGroups.description: Group IDs filtered within the selected source accounts; empty means all their groups. Account and group filters are independent AND conditions.

sourceSenderUids.description: Stable sender UIDs, ORed together. If keywords are also set, sender and keyword conditions are ANDed.

ingestSources.description: Defaults to realtime/latest-poll. Selecting backfill sources changes which newly ingested events are eligible; it does not replay already processed history.

targetId.description: Owned target ID discovered with listNotificationTargets; never guess a chat ID.

destinations.description: Complete destination list. PATCH replaces this list; preserve existing entries when changing one route. Each destination has independent delivery settings.

platform.description: Notification platform of the existing targets and rule.
Notification platform of the existing targets and rule.

hitCount.description: Stored rule/message/keyword hit rows, not unique message count or successful notification count.
